Platform protocol participation (durable): parent-billing reaches modules/delivery/runtime.Capability.EnqueueDeferredPush (delivery-platform) through api.parentBillingLetterPost.EnqueueDocumentNotice. The push of a Träger that a sent confirmation letter is in the inbox of the parents portal is enqueued in the caller's Träger transaction with the record of the send, keyed by the letter and sent with the first stored send only; the worker resolves the parents and their devices when it sends (ADR 0126); transaction, savepoint, after-commit and lock-order correctness stay with the platform behavior tests (ADR 0098).

Platform protocol participation (durable): parent-billing reaches modules/delivery/runtime.Capability.EnqueueEmail (delivery-platform) through api.parentBillingLetterPost.EnqueueLetterMail. The mail of a confirmation letter is a mail of the Träger with the stored PDF in its payload, enqueued in the caller's Träger transaction with the record of the send in parent_billing.document_mailings (ADR 0110, ADR 0123); transaction, savepoint, after-commit and lock-order correctness stay with the platform behavior tests (ADR 0098).
